d.title: Top wo Nerae! Kagaku Kouza
d.jp: トップをねらえ！科学講座
syn: Aim for the Top! Science Lesson
d.synopsis: The science lessons are short "omake" bonus features originally present on the first two volumes of the original release. Each short lasts around two minutes, and stars super deformed versions of Noriko, Kazumi and the Coach explaining the various scientific aspects of the series.

rel.name: Kaette Kita Top wo Nerae! Kagaku Kouza
